headline: Discussed draft procedural rules without action; final adoption planned for the next regular meeting.
summary: The group discussed and worked on a draft of its procedural rules. No action was taken, and no members of the public attended.
decisions: No action taken on the motion to adopt the PIC Rules of Procedure.

CALL TO ORDER 
Meeting called to order:  6:41 p.m. 
ROLL CALL 
Present: Jonah Bradenday, Laura Glendening, Sarah Michniewicz, Norm Proulx, Karsten 
Rees, Jerzy Sylvester. 
  
UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
● Motion to Adopt PIC Rules of Procedure (K. Rees) 
The Peaks Island Council discussed and workshopped the working draft of the PIC 
Procedural Rules, with a plan to adopt a final draft in the October 28 regular meeting. No 
action taken.

No members of the public were present. 
 
ADJOURNMENT
